newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - May 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - May 2.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Privatisation on track again with the expected sell-off of 51 percent of oil refinery Samir, and flotations of Imiter and Sacem mines.
- Education survey shows 58 percent of parents are satisfied with school results.
- Finance ministry to give final touch to 1997 budget on Friday.
- State-owned airline Royal Air Maroc launches publicity campaign to brighten its image abroad. It plans to raise amount devoted to communication.

- Analysts say Casablanca stock exchange does not run risk of collapsing despite downward corrections of recent days. They say the drops are healthy and will act as deterrent to short-term investors who consider trading as gambling.
- Second Holding Societe Nationale d'Investissement (SNI), whose activities focus on the agro-industrial and building sectors, shows interest in steel mill Sonasid.
